summary: Iteration 238: Verified all 3 new Admin Dashboard vacuum control features - Stop Vacuum, Network Selection, and Snapshot History Export/Import. All backend endpoints working correctly. Frontend UI shows all new controls with proper state management.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/snapshot.py (Lines 997-1005): VERIFIED - POST /api/snapshot/vacuum/stop endpoint correctly returns error when no vacuum running, returns stopping:true when vacuum is running
routes/snapshot.py (Lines 939-981): VERIFIED - GET /api/snapshot/status includes stop_requested and network fields in vacuum object
routes/snapshot.py (Lines 1029-1059): VERIFIED - GET /api/snapshot/history/export returns JSON with version, exported_at, snapshots array, snapshot_txids array, and totals
routes/snapshot.py (Lines 1068-1112): VERIFIED - POST /api/snapshot/history/import accepts JSON payload with snapshots and snapshot_txids arrays, uses INSERT OR IGNORE
AdminDashboard.js (Lines 1476-1485): VERIFIED - Network selector dropdown visible when vacuum not running with btc-testnet and btc-mainnet options
AdminDashboard.js (Lines 1487-1496): VERIFIED - Stop Vacuum button visible when vacuum is running, shows 'Stopping...' state when stop_requested
AdminDashboard.js (Lines 1659-1700): VERIFIED - Snapshot History Transfer section with Export and Import buttons, hidden file input for JSON import
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 new vacuum control features are working: (1) Stop Vacuum button appears when vacuum is running and gracefully stops the crawl, (2) Network selector dropdown (btc-testnet/btc-mainnet) appears when vacuum is not running, (3) Snapshot History Transfer section has Export and Import buttons for pushing/consuming snapshot history between instances. Auto-delta scheduler runs both networks automatically on 15-minute intervals.

stop_vacuum_endpoint.details: POST /api/snapshot/vacuum/stop returns {error: 'No vacuum is currently running'} when idle, returns {stopping: true, phase: '...'} when vacuum is running

status_endpoint_fields.details: GET /api/snapshot/status includes vacuum.stop_requested (boolean) and vacuum.network (string) fields

history_export_endpoint.details: GET /api/snapshot/history/export returns JSON with version, exported_at, snapshots array (11 items), snapshot_txids array (6819 items), and totals

history_import_endpoint.details: POST /api/snapshot/history/import accepts JSON payload, returns {success: true, imported_snapshots: N, imported_txids: N}

frontend_stop_vacuum_button.details: Stop Vacuum button (data-testid='stop-vacuum-btn') visible when vacuum running, shows 'Stopping...' state, progress bar turns red

frontend_network_selector.details: Network selector dropdown (data-testid='vacuum-network-select') visible when vacuum not running, has Testnet and Mainnet options

frontend_history_transfer.details: Snapshot History Transfer section has Export History button (data-testid='export-history-btn') and Import History button (data-testid='import-history-btn')
